name: Tsukishiro Chigaya
source:
A genius hacker with poor social skills.

A brilliant genius, who developed narcolepsy after a certain incident in his childhood and has since lived a reclusive life, rarely going outside. He only communicates with others through the cat-like AI “Ruri.”
